theme.title: Mixed / Stock-Picker's Market
theme.summary: Communication Svcs (+1.69%) and Materials (+1.63%) led the market today, while Real Estate (-0.62%) and Technology (-0.42%) brought up the rear. Performance didn't cluster cleanly by style — growth averaged +0.42%, defensives +0.28%, and value/cyclicals +0.50% — more a stock-by-stock market than a single broad theme. Major indices moved in a tighter band — S&P 500 +0.45%, Dow +0.45%, Nasdaq +0.33% — without one clearly dominating. Small caps bucked the broader trend, with the Russell 2000 up +0.82%, outperforming large caps. The VIX fell 5.63% to 15.41, which reads as an orderly rotation rather than panic-driven selling. Gold added 1.58% to $4,417.70, crude oil was little changed at $90.73, and bitcoin slipped 0.34% — cross-asset moves weren't all pointing the same direction as equities.
